<p id="p3" data-pid="3" class="themeScrp">(<a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="58006010" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/hebrews/6/#v58006010" target="_blank">Hebrews 6:10</a>)</p>
<div class="bodyTxt">
<ol class="source">
<li>
<p id="p4" data-pid="4" class="p4 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">1. </span>Life in this world can be hard.</p>
<p id="p5" data-pid="5" class="p5 sz">Life in this world can bring tears and pain.</p>
<p id="p6" data-pid="6" class="p6 sp">Still ev’ry day I will say,</p>
<p id="p7" data-pid="7" class="p7 sz">“My life is not in vain.”</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p8" data-pid="8" class="p8 se">(CHORUS)</p>
<p id="p9" data-pid="9" class="p9 sp">For God is not unrighteous,</p>
<p id="p10" data-pid="10" class="p10 sz">And he remembers the love I’ve shown.</p>
<p id="p11" data-pid="11" class="p11 sp">So he is ever near me;</p>
<p id="p12" data-pid="12" class="p12 sz">With Jehovah, I’m not alone.</p>
<p id="p13" data-pid="13" class="p13 sp">Yes, God is my provider</p>
<p id="p14" data-pid="14" class="p14 sz">and my protector down to the end.</p>
<p id="p15" data-pid="15" class="p15 sp">Yes, Jehovah is my Father,</p>
<p id="p16" data-pid="16" class="p16 sz">My God and Friend.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p17" data-pid="17" class="p17 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">2. </span>Gone are the days of my youth;</p>
<p id="p18" data-pid="18" class="p18 sz">Days of calamity now are here.</p>
<p id="p19" data-pid="19" class="p19 sp">Still through the eyes of my faith,</p>
<p id="p20" data-pid="20" class="p20 sz">My hope is bright and clear.</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p21" data-pid="21" class="p21 se">(CHORUS)</p>
<p id="p22" data-pid="22" class="p22 sp">For God is not unrighteous,</p>
<p id="p23" data-pid="23" class="p23 sz">And he remembers the love I’ve shown.</p>
<p id="p24" data-pid="24" class="p24 sp">So he is ever near me;</p>
<p id="p25" data-pid="25" class="p25 sz">With Jehovah, I’m not alone.</p>
<p id="p26" data-pid="26" class="p26 sp">Yes, God is my provider</p>
<p id="p27" data-pid="27" class="p27 sz">and my protector down to the end.</p>
<p id="p28" data-pid="28" class="p28 sp">Yes, Jehovah is my Father,</p>
<p id="p29" data-pid="29" class="p29 sz">My God and Friend.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="closingContent">
<p id="p30" data-pid="30" class="p30 se">(See also <a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19071017-19071018" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/psalms/71/#v19071017-v19071018" target="_blank">Ps. 71:17, 18</a>.)</p>
</div>
<p id="p31" class="displayNone"> </p>
